lines.text: The word of the LORD came to Jeremiah about Pharaoh Neco's army, defeated at Carchemish by Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon.
After orders to prepare for battle, the LORD sees warriors terrified and retreating, fleeing in haste without looking back.
Egypt rises like the Jordan, boasting that it will cover the earth and destroy cities and their people.
Warriors from Cush, Put, and Lydia come forth, and the Lord GOD of Hosts will hold a sacrifice.
Egypt is told to go up to Bashan for balm, but there is no healing for her.
